description: Page-label editor rendering removable label chips, an add-input with autocomplete suggestions, and a per-label filter panel listing pages sharing the label, persisting through the data provider.

parameters.name: PageId
parameters.description: Identifier of the page whose labels are edited.

parameters.name: Labels
parameters.description: Current labels assigned to the page.

parameters.name: OnLabelsChanged
parameters.description: Raised after labels are successfully persisted.
